post.description:
Operator/recovery endpoint: force a job to the terminal
CANCELLED state.

The supported alternative to hand-editing the prod `jobs` table
when a job is orphaned in RUNNING (e.g. a poll worker wedged on a
no-timeout call and was restarted; nothing reclaims a stale
RUNNING row). Also sets `cancel_requested` so a still-live worker
can cooperatively bail. See issue #48.

Upsert a JobDefinition record into the catalog.

The client computes the `id` as `"{name}@{version}"`; the service
validates the join, the runtime selector, and writes. Re-POSTing
the same `(name, version)` overwrites — that's the intended bundle-
redeploy ergonomic.

post.description:
Merge-upsert workflow descriptors into the blob the GET endpoints serve.

This is the deploy-flow seam for #56: a domain-side `export-workflows`
(engine context) emits the descriptors as JSON, and the standalone CLI
POSTs them here. **Merge**, not replace — posted job types are upserted
and existing ones preserved — so each runtime can push only the job
types it can see (`default`, `crewai`, …) and they accumulate into the
single blob. Idempotent: re-pushing the same descriptors is a no-op.

Deploy a prompt — the domain-facing write path, mirroring
`POST /artifact-types`. **Upsert by content** (issue #59): a new name is
created, an edited one is stored as a version-bumped copy, and an
unchanged one is a no-op. The `action` field reports which, so a deploy
tool can show created/updated/unchanged. Re-deploys stay safe and
idempotent; identical content never churns the version.

ArtifactSummary.title: ArtifactSummary
ArtifactSummary.description:
Lightweight row for the artifact list view — enough to render
the index and filter without hydrating every full artifact.

ArtifactTypeRecord.title: ArtifactTypeRecord
ArtifactTypeRecord.description:
Plain-data record for an artifact type.

Keyed `(name, version)` where `name` is the discriminator string
(e.g. "math_question", "ai_answer", "math_conversation") and
version follows the same defaulting story as JobDefinition.

ArtifactTypeSpec.title: ArtifactTypeSpec
ArtifactTypeSpec.description:
One registered artifact type — `BaseArtifact` subclass projected
into a UI-friendly registry entry. Drives the `/artifact-types`
viewer.

BatchArtifactRequest.title: BatchArtifactRequest
BatchArtifactRequest.description:
Body for `POST /artifacts/batch` — hydrate many artifacts in one
round-trip (replaces a `GET /artifacts/{id}` per id). Fails loud:
any missing id 404s the whole batch, matching `get_many`.

chunk_id.title: Chunk Id
chunk_id.description: Id of the chunk in the domain vector table.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Structural node the chunk belongs to.

token_count.title: Token Count
token_count.description: Approximate token length of the chunk.

BookChunkRef.title: BookChunkRef
BookChunkRef.description:
A manifest entry for one embedded chunk — a nested child of the
`BookIndexArtifact`.

The chunk *body* + its vector live in the domain pgvector table
(`math_book_chunks`, keyed by `book_id` + `chunk_id`); this is only the
catalog entry (id, owning node, embedding model) so a reader can enumerate
what was indexed without hitting the table. Never carries the raw vector.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Edge confidence (retrieval expansion floors on it).

BookEdge.title: BookEdge
BookEdge.description:
One directed relation between two `BookNode`s — a nested child of the
`BookStructureArtifact`.

`source`/`target` are `BookNode.node_id`s. `kind` says what the relation is
(`contains`/`parent_of` for structure; `next`/`previous` reading order;
`proven_by` proof linkage; `references`/`referenced_by` the resolved
citations retrieval expands along; `has_equation` math regions). `confidence`
is ported from the spike's `Edge.confidence` — `expand()` (#64) drops edges
below a floor.

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: Id of the book this index covers.

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description: Embedding model used across the chunks.

vector_table.title: Vector Table
vector_table.description: Domain pgvector table the chunks/vectors were persisted to.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Artifact shape version (1 = initial scaffold contract).

BookIndexArtifact.title: BookIndexArtifact
BookIndexArtifact.description:
The chunk/index manifest for one indexed book.

Minted by the `book_index` job after chunk+embed (platform
`EmbeddingsInterpreter`) → persist into the domain pgvector table. Records
*what* was indexed (`chunks`, `chunk_count`, `embedding_model`, the vector
table name) so a reader knows the book is retrievable and how; the vectors
themselves stay in the domain table (§13). Populating this is #63.

pdf_ref.title: Pdf Ref
pdf_ref.description: storage_ref of the uploaded book PDF (POST /media).

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: Stable id namespacing this book's chunks/nodes/edges.

page_range.description: Optional inclusive page window; omit to index the whole book.

BookIndexInput.title: BookIndexInput
BookIndexInput.description:
Submit input for a `book_index` job.

`pdf_ref` is the uploaded book PDF (a `storage_ref` from the `POST /media`
response). `book_id` namespaces every chunk/node/edge this job produces —
the domain pgvector table and the artifacts are all keyed on it, so a
re-index of the same `book_id` supersedes the prior one. `page_range` is an
optional slice; omit to index the whole book.

chunk_count.title: Chunk Count
chunk_count.description: Chunks embedded into the vector table.

structure.description: The minted skeleton artifact (by value, hydrated).

BookIndexResult.title: BookIndexResult
BookIndexResult.description:
Typed result for a `book_index` job — the minted artifacts, by ref, plus
a compact summary of what got indexed.

The canonical artifacts (`BookStructureArtifact`, `BookIndexArtifact`) are
resolved by ref; the scalar counts here are a cheap at-a-glance summary so a
caller needn't hydrate the artifacts to know the index ran.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: node_id of the containing node (structural tree).

heading_path.title: Heading Path
heading_path.description: Breadcrumb from the book root (chapter › §section › subsection).

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based source page where the node starts.

page_end.title: Page End
page_end.description: 1-based source page where the node ends.

text.title: Text
text.description: Faithful (normalized) body text of the node.

proves.title: Proves
proves.description: For a proof node: node_id of the theorem-like node it proves.

BookNode.title: BookNode
BookNode.description:
One structural node in a book's skeleton — a nested child of the
`BookStructureArtifact` (never an artifact of its own).

`node_id` is stable within a `book_id` (the retrieval job's graph expansion
and every `BookRetrievalHit.node_id` reference it). `label` is the
human-readable citation stub (e.g. `Theorem 7.7`, `§7`).

Fields beyond `node_id`/`kind`/`label`/`title`/`page` are ported from the
spike's Track-A `Node`
(`origin/spike/extraction-skeleton:spikes/book-rag/_shared/schema.py`) — the
grounding graph (Track B) + contextualized chunking (Track C) rely on
`parent_id`, `heading_path`, `proves`, and the page span. All optional with
defaults, so this stays additive vs the #60 scaffold shape.

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: Id of the book retrieved over.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Intent used to steer retrieval, if any.

reranked.title: Reranked
reranked.description: Whether a Claude rerank pass ran.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Artifact shape version (1 = initial scaffold contract).

BookRetrievalArtifact.title: BookRetrievalArtifact
BookRetrievalArtifact.description:
The result of one `book_retrieve` job — the ranked, source-traceable hits.

Minted by the retrieve job so a run's answer is ref-resolvable like every
other job's output (`GET /artifacts/{id}`). Small by design: the hits (with
node_id + label + page + heading_path for traceability), the echoed query,
and the retrieval config used.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Structural node the chunk belongs to.

source.title: Source
source.description: Pre-rendered human-readable citation (heading path + label + page).

BookRetrievalHit.title: BookRetrievalHit
BookRetrievalHit.description:
One ranked, source-traceable retrieval hit.

`chunk_id` / `node_id` tie the hit back to the indexed corpus (source
traceability was the spike's headline metric); `text` is the chunk body;
`score` is the final (post-rerank) rank score. The traceability fields
(`label` / `page` / `heading_path`) are the structured citation the design
requires; `source` is the same, pre-rendered as one human-readable string the
UI can show directly.

BookRetrievalResult.title: BookRetrievalResult
BookRetrievalResult.description: Typed result for a `book_retrieve` job — the ranked hits (+ echoed query).

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: The indexed book to retrieve over.

k.title: K
k.description: Number of ranked hits to return.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Optional intent steering the hybrid mix / graph expansion.

BookRetrieveInput.title: BookRetrieveInput
BookRetrieveInput.description:
Submit input for a `book_retrieve` job.

Retrieves over the book previously indexed under `book_id`. `query` is the
natural-language question; `k` is the number of ranked hits to return.
`intent` optionally steers the hybrid mix / graph expansion (spike Track C).

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: Id of the book this skeleton belongs to.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Artifact shape version (1 = initial scaffold contract).

BookStructureArtifact.title: BookStructureArtifact
BookStructureArtifact.description:
The structural skeleton of one indexed book — nodes + edges.

Minted by the `book_index` job (extraction ← spike Track A, graph ← Track B).
`book_id` namespaces it; `nodes`/`edges` carry the skeleton. Populating them
is #63; this scaffold fixes the shape so retrieval (#64) can rely on it.

CodePackageRecord.title: CodePackageRecord
CodePackageRecord.description:
Metadata pointer to an installable code blob.

`blob_id` is the FileRepository logical name (filename within the
`code_packages` prefix) — fetching the bytes goes through the
file repository, not this record.

page.title: Page
page.description: Book page, if the node carries one.

text.title: Text
text.description: The node's real book body — or, for a container section/subsection, its descendant leaf bodies stitched together. The actual content the map drills into (empty if the node carries no extractable text).

ConstellationAnchor.title: ConstellationAnchor
ConstellationAnchor.description:
One source-grounded point of a constellation — a real book-graph node.

Mirrors `book.constellation.Anchor`: `role` is `"seed"` for a note-derived
seed node and `"gravity"` for a node the walk pulled in for its pull on the
seeds. Never a fabricated coordinate — every anchor is a real graph node.

ConstellationEdge.title: ConstellationEdge
ConstellationEdge.description:
One edge of the gravity skeleton binding the anchors together — mirrors
`book.constellation.ConnectingEdge`.

score.title: Score
score.description: Aggregate gravity score of the constellation.

seed_node_ids.title: Seed Node Ids
seed_node_ids.description: The seed node_ids the constellation grew from.

story.title: Story
story.description: ONE short grounded narrative binding the anchors (None if unwritten).

ConstellationPayload.title: ConstellationPayload
ConstellationPayload.description:
The retrieval product persisted on a mentor card — the anchors, the edges
that connect them, the aggregate gravity `score`, the `seed_node_ids` it grew
from, and the grounded `story` narrated over it.

Mirrors `book.constellation.Constellation` field-for-field so S1's dataclass
round-trips cleanly through the artifact. `from_constellation` does the
dataclass → model convert by reading attributes only (never importing S1's
engine), so it works against the pinned S1 contract.

ConversationTurn.title: ConversationTurn
ConversationTurn.description:
A single agent move in the conversation.

Embedded in `MathConversationArtifact.turns` and mirrored on
`MathConversationState.turns` while the run is in flight. `latex`
and `figure` are inline — the math-ui `<Latex>` component and figure
renderer take these values directly.

CrewChatEvent.title: CrewChatEvent
CrewChatEvent.description:
One event in the live conversation stream.

Mirrors `docs/math_conversation.md` → Live visibility. Optional
fields are populated per event kind (e.g. `content` on `message`,
`tool_name` on `tool_call`).

note_date.title: Note Date
note_date.description: The study day this note belongs to.

ocr_text.title: Ocr Text
ocr_text.description: Legacy combined text/LaTeX parsed from the note's photos.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Document shape version (1=pre-redesign, 2=document, 3=magnitude + enriched synthesis shape, 4=adaptive/sectioned synthesis).

DailyNoteArtifact.title: DailyNoteArtifact
DailyNoteArtifact.description:
One captured study note, tied to a calendar day — a self-contained document.

`storage_ref` / `content_type` / `byte_size` are inherited from
`BaseArtifact` and point at the uploaded **audio** blob. `transcript` is
the voice-note transcription; `pages` holds the raw per-photo extraction
(children); `synthesis` is the cleaned-up note-level math. `image_refs`
holds the notebook-photo storage_refs.

`pages`, `synthesis`, `magnitude`, and `schema_version` are additive
(optional with defaults) so old rows — written before the redesign — still
hydrate under the current class. `schema_version` is the migration's
idempotency marker: old rows default to 1; the document redesign is 2; rows
carrying `magnitude` (and the enriched, section-capable `synthesis` shape)
are 3.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: The validated semantic figure spec — opaque JSON.

FigureArtifact.title: FigureArtifact
FigureArtifact.description:
Validated semantic figure spec (Munkres / Lee / Tu style).

Produced by `RenderFigureStep` after the agent has converged on
a structurally valid spec via the `validate_figure` tool. The
`spec` is an opaque JSON payload — the FEATURES.md plan calls
for keeping it as `dict[str, Any]` server-side; the renderer
contract lives in `math-ui`. `template` is duplicated out of the
spec for indexable filtering.

book_id.title: Book Id
book_id.description: The book this anchor points into (namespacing).

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Structural node id — copied from a hit ONLY on a coordinate match.

label.title: Label
label.description: Citation label (e.g. 'Problem 2.16') — copied from a hit ONLY on a coordinate match.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based source page, if the grounding hit carried one.

heading_path.title: Heading Path
heading_path.description: Breadcrumb from the book root (grounding hit's section).

source.title: Source
source.description: Pre-rendered human-readable citation from the grounding hit.

score.title: Score
score.description: Score of the grounding hit, if any.

query.title: Query
query.description: The query used for retrieval (coordinate if given, else topic).

trust_level.title: Trust Level
trust_level.description: grounded | section-grounded | ungrounded — how much to trust this anchor.

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: True iff trust_level != 'ungrounded' (something usable was found).

GroundedAnchor.title: GroundedAnchor
GroundedAnchor.description:
A source-traceable pointer into a book, with an honest trust level.

Field set is the authoritative #68 contract — do not add/rename fields.

Invariant enforced by `resolve_anchor`:
``matched == (trust_level != "ungrounded")``. `label`/`node_id` are only ever
populated by copying a returned hit — never synthesized.

JobDefinitionRecord.title: JobDefinitionRecord
JobDefinitionRecord.description:
Plain-data record of a job's control plane.

Keyed `(name, version)`. The id is the derived `"{name}@{version}"`
string; downstream callers reference it by `id` (versioned) or by
`name` (latest) depending on the path.

LatexAnswerArtifact.title: LatexAnswerArtifact
LatexAnswerArtifact.description:
Validated LaTeX rendering of an AI answer.

Produced by `GenerateLatexStep` after the agent has converged on
KaTeX-compilable source via the `validate_latex` tool. `is_valid`
is always True at persistence time — invalid drafts never escape
the validation loop. `validation_attempts` records how many
rounds of tool feedback the agent took to converge.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: Single log record emitted by the worker for one job.

MathConversationArtifact.title: MathConversationArtifact
MathConversationArtifact.description:
The whole brainstorm transcript, persisted once at end-of-run.

`seed_question` is the question the panel explored — pulled from a
source `math_qa` job's artifacts or wrapped from fresh input text.
`source_job_id` records provenance when seeded from a prior job.

source_job_id.title: Source Job Id
source_job_id.description: Seed from a completed math_qa job's artifacts.

question_text.title: Question Text
question_text.description: Fresh question to brainstorm (when not seeding from a job).

MathConversationInput.title: MathConversationInput
MathConversationInput.description:
Typed submit input — a variant of the platform request union.

Exactly one of `source_job_id` (seed from a completed `math_qa` job)
or `question_text` (fresh question) must be set; the validator
rejects "both" and "neither" at the API boundary.

MathConversationResult.title: MathConversationResult
MathConversationResult.description:
Typed result — a variant of the platform result union.

The single `conversation` artifact is resolved from `artifact_refs`
by the result endpoint's hydrator.

note_id.title: Note Id
note_id.description: Trailing-edge DailyNoteArtifact id to anchor the window (the just-captured note).

note_date.title: Note Date
note_date.description: Reference study day the trailing window ends at; defaults to today.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: The learner whose daily notes to read (scopes the window).

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: How many trailing days of notes to read; None = execution default.

MathMentorInput.title: MathMentorInput
MathMentorInput.description:
Submit input for a `math_mentor` job — locate the trailing daily-note window.

The mentor loop reads a learner's recent `daily_note` artifacts ending at a
reference day. `created_by` scopes retrieval to one learner; `note_id` /
`note_date` pin the window's trailing edge (the just-captured note, or the
day to look back from); `window_days` bounds how far back to read. All are
optional so the job can be triggered either by a specific note (`note_id`) or
for a learner+date, with the execution node resolving sensible defaults.

card_ref.title: Card Ref
card_ref.description: Id of the minted MentorCardArtifact, or None if the mentor stayed silent.

MathMentorResult.title: MathMentorResult
MathMentorResult.description:
Typed result for a `math_mentor` job — the minted card, by ref (if any).

The mentor brain is restraint-first: most runs mint nothing. `card_ref` is
the id of the `MentorCardArtifact` that fired, or `None` when the mentor
stayed silent for this window.

audio_ref.title: Audio Ref
audio_ref.description: storage_ref of the uploaded voice note (POST /media).

image_refs.title: Image Refs
image_refs.description: Optional notebook-photo storage_refs captured with the note.

flairs.title: Flairs
flairs.description: Learner directives steering the synthesis (e.g. dont_spoil).

MathNotesInput.title: MathNotesInput
MathNotesInput.description:
Submit input for a `math_notes` ingest job.

`audio_ref` is the voice note to transcribe (a `storage_ref` from the
`POST /media` response); `image_refs` are optional notebook photos
captured alongside it. `note_date` defaults to today (resolved in the
graph node) when omitted. `flairs` are learner directives that steer the
synthesis (e.g. `dont_spoil` — don't finish/reveal an unfinished exercise).

MathNotesResult.title: MathNotesResult
MathNotesResult.description: Typed result for a `math_notes` job — the minted note, by ref.

MathQAInput.title: MathQAInput
MathQAInput.description: Typed submit input for a Math Q&A job — variant of the platform request union.

MathQAResult.title: MathQAResult
MathQAResult.description:
Typed result for a Math Q&A job — variant of the platform result union.

Each typed field is an artifact resolved from `artifact_refs` (defined
on `BaseJobResult`). The result endpoint hydrates them via the
workspace artifact store.

MediaRef.title: MediaRef
MediaRef.description:
Handle for an uploaded blob — what `POST /media` returns and what
a domain stamps onto a `storage_ref`-backed `BaseArtifact`.

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Repair flavor: abandonment | unverified_proof (None on a constellation card).

catch.title: Catch
catch.description: The learner's verbatim quote (== decision.quote); repair card.

why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters
why_it_matters.description: One line: why this is the crux, not bookkeeping (repair card).

move.title: Move
move.description: Exactly one book-anchored directive (contains the citation), one sitting (repair card).

close.title: Close
close.description: A concrete WHEN ('I'll ask you about it on Sunday'); repair card.

on_his_side.title: On His Side
on_his_side.description: One SPECIFIC REAL win pulled from the same note (not generic praise); repair card.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: Trust-aware citation (label + book + page) rendered only from the anchor; repair card.

anchor.description: The GroundedAnchor a repair card is rooted in (book coordinate + provenance).

trust_level.title: Trust Level
trust_level.description: A repair anchor's trust level — grounded | section-grounded.

constellation.description: The grounded constellation (anchors+edges+score+seeds+story); None on a repair card.

source_note_date.title: Source Note Date
source_note_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the note this card is rooted in.

text.title: Text
text.description: The rendered card the learner reads (repair ~4-line, or the constellation story).

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: The learner this card is for.

MentorCardArtifact.title: MentorCardArtifact
MentorCardArtifact.description:
One minted **mentor card** — a *repair card* OR a *constellation card*.

The mentor loop reads a trailing window of `DailyNoteArtifact`s and, with
restraint, mints **at most one** card per run. There are two shapes of the one
artifact:

* **Constellation card** (S3, #96 — the current production shape). The run
  derives seeds from the note's extracted concepts, retrieves a
  `Constellation` (far-apart-yet-connected book places, grounded ONLY in the
  book graph), narrates ONE grounded ``story`` over it, and persists that on
  ``constellation`` (with ``text`` == the story). The repair anatomy is unset.
* **Repair card** (the original shape). The field set mirrors
  ``mathai.math_notes.mentor.repair_card.compose_repair_card``'s output
  verbatim — the five anatomy parts (``catch`` / ``why_it_matters`` / ``move``
  / ``close`` / ``on_his_side``), the trust-aware ``citation`` rendered only
  from the anchor, the ``flavor``, the assembled ~4-line ``text`` — plus the
  full source-traceable `GroundedAnchor` and its denormalized ``trust_level``.

The repair anatomy fields are OPTIONAL so the same artifact type carries both
shapes; a reader distinguishes them by which of ``constellation`` / ``flavor``
is set. Whatever the shape, the card is grounded ONLY in real book
coordinates — never a fabricated one. ``schema_version`` (see
``MENTOR_CARD_SCHEMA_VERSION``) marks the shape: 1 = repair-only, 2 = carries
the constellation payload.

NoteFlair.title: NoteFlair
NoteFlair.description:
A learner directive attached to a note that steers the synthesis.

A flair is a structured, first-class instruction (vs. one buried in the
transcript) the synthesis pass MUST honor — it overrides the default
silent-corrector behavior. The directive *text* for each flair lives in the
prompt registry as `math_notes.flair.<value>` (deployed via
`aiplatform deploy-prompts` from `instructions/flair/<value>.md`) and is
fetched at synthesis time, so the wording is tunable without a redeploy;
this enum is just the typed, validated set of keys the UI offers.

transcript_chars.title: Transcript Chars
transcript_chars.description: Character length of the voice-note transcript.

page_count.title: Page Count
page_count.description: Number of notebook pages captured (strongest scope proxy).

page_chars.title: Page Chars
page_chars.description: Total chars of faithful per-page transcription.

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Audio duration if the transcription surfaced it (minor signal).

NoteMagnitude.title: NoteMagnitude
NoteMagnitude.description:
Multi-modal density signal for a note — "how much" it contains.

Fuses the three modalities into one struct: `transcript_chars` (what they
said), `page_count` + `page_chars` (what they wrote, the strongest scope
proxy), and `duration_seconds` (a minor, often-absent signal — the default
transcription model doesn't surface it). `density_tier` is the coarse bucket
downstream synthesis reads to scale its depth/effort. Threaded on
`MathNotesState` and persisted on `DailyNoteArtifact` (additive).

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: Faithful plain-text transcription of the page.

diagram_description.title: Diagram Description
diagram_description.description: Description of any diagram/figure on the page.

NotePage.title: NotePage
NotePage.description:
Faithful extraction of one notebook photo — a nested child of the note.

Raw-only by design: `raw_text` is a faithful transcription of what's on
the page (no LaTeX, no concepts — those are reconstructed note-level in
`NoteSynthesis`). Held on `MathNotesState` in-flight and stored inline on
`DailyNoteArtifact.pages`; never an artifact of its own.

note_date.title: Note Date
note_date.description: The study day this page belongs to.

latex.title: Latex
latex.description: Math on the page, transcribed as LaTeX.

diagram_description.title: Diagram Description
diagram_description.description: Description of any diagram/figure on the page.

NotePageArtifact.title: NotePageArtifact
NotePageArtifact.description:
LEGACY per-photo artifact — no longer minted, kept for back-compat.

Before the document redesign, each photo was minted as its own
`note_page` row linked to the parent via `source_note_id`. New ingests
embed page data on `DailyNoteArtifact.pages` instead, but this class stays
registered so old rows still hydrate on read and the migration
(`scripts/migrate_notes_to_document.py`) can query them as its source.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Short topical heading for the section (e.g. a `##` title).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Prose + embedded KaTeX-validated LaTeX for this section.

NoteSection.title: NoteSection
NoteSection.description:
One topical section of a note's synthesis — a heading, its prose+math,
and the concepts it touches.

The structured counterpart to the flat `markdown` blob: a multi-topic study
session can render as one `NoteSection` per topic (each its own
KaTeX-validated Markdown + concepts) instead of collapsing into a single
block. Additive — short, single-topic notes leave `sections` empty and keep
using the flat `markdown` field. Populating these is the adaptive/segmented
synthesis pass's job (epic #14, S4); this story (S5) just owns the shape.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Prose + embedded KaTeX-validated LaTeX for the whole note.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A short prose summary of the note.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Per-topic sections for a multi-topic note (empty for short notes).

depth_tier.title: Depth Tier
depth_tier.description: Depth the synthesis rendered at (brief|standard|deep); None if unset.

magnitude.description: Density signal the synthesis depth was scaled to (S1's NoteMagnitude).

model_used.title: Model Used
model_used.description: The model that produced the synthesis.

validation_attempts.title: Validation Attempts
validation_attempts.description: How many validate_latex calls before converging.

NoteSynthesis.title: NoteSynthesis
NoteSynthesis.description:
The note-level synthesis — one coherent, always-correct view of the math.

Produced by the synthesis pass over the transcript + all page extractions.
`markdown` is prose with embedded KaTeX-validated LaTeX (document mode);
`concepts` and `summary` are note-level. Never reproduces an error the
learner made — it reconstructs the intended math silently.

Enriched (epic #14, S5) so a substantial session is more than one flat blob:
`sections` carries per-topic structure, `depth_tier` marks how deep the
synthesis rendered, and `magnitude` embeds the fused density signal the
depth was scaled to. All three are additive (optional / default-empty) — the
flat `markdown` stays the canonical field for short notes and back-compat,
and rows written before the enrichment hydrate unchanged.

PageRange.title: PageRange
PageRange.description:
An inclusive 1-based page window into the source PDF.

Optional on `BookIndexInput`: omit to index the whole book. Lets a caller
index a slice (e.g. the spike's representative `Ch1 §1–§3 + Ch7 §7`) without
parsing the entire PDF.

PromptCreateRequest.title: PromptCreateRequest
PromptCreateRequest.description:
Body for `POST /prompts` — a domain deploying one of its prompts.
Get-or-create / idempotent on `name` (mirrors `POST /artifact-types`):
an existing prompt is left untouched; use `PUT` to change instructions.

PromptDeployResponse.title: PromptDeployResponse
PromptDeployResponse.description:
`POST /prompts` result. `action` tells a deploy tool whether the
request created a new prompt, version-bumped an edited one, or was a
no-op — so `aip deploy` can report created/updated/unchanged instead of
a blanket "✓" that hides silently-dropped edits (issue #59).

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Structural node the chunk belongs to.

RetrievedHit.title: RetrievedHit
RetrievedHit.description:
One ranked, source-traceable hit stored on a `BookRetrievalArtifact`.

Mirrors `models.BookRetrievalHit` (the job-result shape) but defined here so
the artifact layer carries no import from `models` (models → artifacts is the
one-directional dependency). `node_id`/`label`/`page`/`heading_path` are the
source-traceability fields the design requires.

RootModel_Annotated_Union_MathNotesInput.title: RootModel[Annotated[Union[MathNotesInput, BookIndexInput, BookRetrieveInput, MathMentorInput, MathConversationInput, MathQAInput], FieldInfo(annotation=NoneType, required=True, discriminator='job_type')]]

ToolCallRecord.title: ToolCallRecord
ToolCallRecord.description: One tool invocation an agent made inside a turn.

is_correct.title: Is Correct
is_correct.description: Did the user mark the answer correct?

UserComment.title: UserComment
UserComment.description: User feedback on an AI response.

WorkflowListItem.title: WorkflowListItem
WorkflowListItem.description: Lightweight registry entry — drives the platform-level workflow index.

WorkflowsPushRequest.title: WorkflowsPushRequest
WorkflowsPushRequest.description: A map of `{job_type: descriptor}` to merge into the workflows blob.

ai_platform__jobs__workflow_schemas__Gat.title: GateSpec
ai_platform__jobs__workflow_schemas__Gat.description:
Execution-policy gate — declares that after `node_name` runs,
a human review of `review_type` must be submitted before the
workflow continues.

ai_platform__workspace__storage__structu.title: GateSpec
ai_platform__workspace__storage__structu.description:
A single human-review gate carried by a JobDefinition.

`review_schema` is the pydantic `model_json_schema()` of the review
body — the API uses it to validate `POST /jobs/{id}/review` once the
catalog drives routing. For now it's recorded for completeness.
